summary.text: Clay Doggett is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 70, which covers Giles County and parts of Lawrence and Lincoln counties, who lives in Pulaski, took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Doggett was born on September 5, 1983, and earned bachelor's degrees in history and political science from the University of Alabama in Huntsville and attended the Tennessee Law Enforcement Training Academy.
The legislature's biography lists him as a small business owner.
Doggett has been a member of the House since the 111th General Assembly and served as Majority Secretary in the 111th.
He chairs the Criminal Justice Subcommittee and is a member of the Agriculture & Natural Resources and Judiciary committees.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Rayanne Moos in the general election.
